en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard view of a harbor scene showing large docked ships in front of a long waterfront industrial building with gabled façades. The water occupies the foreground, while the background shows cranes and port infrastructure. Printed German text at the top reads 'Windau — Das Kühlhause'. The image appears aged and worn, with stains and scratches.
